content: अवभृथः [अव-भृ-क्थन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 3</ls>] .²1 The end or completion of a principal sacrifice; तन्मरणमेवास्यावभृथः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 17. 5</ls>. .²2 Bathing at the end of a principal sacrifice for purification; नावभृथं सरस्वत्याम् <ls>Kāty.</ls>; भुवं कोष्णेन कुण्डोध्नी मेध्येनावभृथादपि <ls>R. 1. 84</ls>; प्रीत्याश्वमेधावभृथार्द्रमूर्तेः <ls n="R.">6. 61</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 22</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 31</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 61</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 244</ls>; <ls>Ms. 11. 82</ls>. .²3 Purification by bathing of the sacrificer and the sacrificial vessels at the end of a sacrifice; अच्छावभृथमोजसा <ls>Rv. 8. 93. 23</ls>. .²4 The water of purification. .²5 A supplementary sacrifice to atone for defects in a principal and preceding one; a sacrifice in general; स्नातवत्यवभृथे ततस्त्वयि <ls>Śi. 14. 10</ls>.
